notes.title: Localisation Patch
notes.content:
[b]Gather round, mighty barbarians![/b]

We’re roaring with excitement that ELDERBORN is still surrounded by such a loyal horde, and that you keep returning to our savage Heavy Metal slasher. From this point, we’d also like to give a loud, thunderous welcome to all the new fearless warriors, eager to become merciless slayers and venture into this brutal world to crush skulls and carve their place in history as badass legends.

But let’s put down our spears and hammers for a sec, because we’ve got some news for you today.

We've been hearing your requests to add new languages to ELDERBORN for a while now. 
Ever since they first came in, we’ve been wanting to meet those expectations and make sure players who speak these languages can fully immerse themselves in the game.
However, there are some limitations. Some of you suggested that we try using AI tools to bring in these translations, even if just temporarily. After much deliberation, we decided to give this a try, and that’s why we’ve decided to go with this experimental solution.

Today we’re adding localisations for [b]Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese[/b], and [b]Korean.[/b] 
As we’ve used AI based tools, they may contain mistranslations, yet we trust it’s still something that might help you dive into the game. This is why we're treating this as an experimental implementation, and we're counting on your feedback in this matter.

To make sure we don't miss any of your voices, we've prepared a separate channel on our Discord,  [b]Elderborn-Localisations[/b], where we'd love to hear your thoughts on this solution and whether the translations are helpful for you. Feel free to let us know if anything seems off, so we can fix it.

Here’s the direct link: https://discord.gg/5MhMjcuT


Several expected questions we can address right away:

Q: Why aren't we using professional translators?
A: We actively work with many translators. ELDERBORN's budget didn't account for other translations.

Q: Are we planning to replace our translators with AI tools?
A: Absolutely not. Using these tools is to aid in these cases where our resources are limited.



We appreciate your feedback to the specified Discord channel so we can make sure everyone’s heard.


Thanks to you, we keep crushing it and pushing forward.

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

Hyperstrange-developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url], the action-packed DOOM Eternal-like spin-off of the POSTAL series is finally here, and  if you own any of the eligible RWS or Hyperstrange titles, or some other staple throwback-shooters like DUSK, Hedon, or Nightmare Reaper, you can get PBD with an additional discount added on top of -20% release discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]via one of the special bundle deals[/b][/url].

But it wouldn't be a POSTAL release if something haven't gone wrong. Many of you were waiting for the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged Official Soundtrack[/url]. The wait is finally over! (ETA: One month)

[*] [b]More to be announced![/b]
[/list]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]

notes.content:
[h2]WARRIORS![/h2]

As the Autumn Steam Sale approaches, we bring you news of a long-awaited update, and we've also brought along a friend. We're teaming up with [b]Hedon dev[/b] to bring you the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23853/Thicc__Brutal/]Thicc & Brutal Bundle[/url][/b] - get [b]ELDERBORN[/b] & [b]Hedon Bloodrite[/b] together or complete your collection for an [i][b]EXTRA 20% discount[/b][/i]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23853/Thicc__Brutal/

As for the update - you should be glad to hear that it includes a complete rework of the way controllers are handled by ELDERBORN. But there's much more to it, scroll below to see the full changelog. And Hedon?

You don't know Hedon? Well... take a look, and see why ELDERBORN and Hedon are a match made in... uh... Valhalla? Hell? Power Metal themepark? Yeah, one of those.

[previewyoutube=Urn7VKNYC5A;full][/previewyoutube]

You will notice that the  [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23853/Thicc__Brutal/]Thicc & Brutal Bundle[/url][/b] is not the only bundle featured on the ELDERBORN store page. Make sure to check out the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23043/The_Action_Hyperpack/]Action Hyper-Pack[/url][/b], a collection of 3 unique Hyperstrange originals - this might be a great opportunity for you to pick up our newest title - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE/][b]RAYZE[/b][/url]!

[h2]FULL CHANGELOG[/h2]
Today's [b]ELDERBORN[/b] update is the result of our steady progress towards improving the PC version of the game, while preparing it for the upcoming console launch. It's quite diverse in terms of areas that have been tinkered with. Work has been done here and there - here's a comprehensive list of changes.
[h3]MAJOR[/h3]

notes.title: ELDERBORN: New Game +
notes.content:
[b]Warriors![/b]

It's been almost two months since we've unleashed all the mysterious mayhem of the ancient cursed city upon you. Your reaction to [b]ELDERBORN[/b] is - there's no other way to put it - AWESOME AF! It seems that we managed to hit all the spots we were aiming for. The Heavy Metal feel. The old-school, 90s, and 80s love. The dynamic FPP environment. The souls-like level challenge, combat flow, and exploration. The reviews you drop on our Steam page day by day are not only heartwarming, but also encourage us to keep at it!

[previewyoutube=Cx3nSKtdtEk;full][/previewyoutube]

We appreciate all the kind words. We appreciate the critique as well. Now, to make [b]ELDERBORN[/b] an even better game. We give you...

[h2]The "New Game+" update![/h2]

The [b]NG+[/b] mode is just one of the features of today's update. We wanted you to be able to pick up your game after beating the campaign, but we also wanted to make your continued time with ELDERBORN even more enjoyable. That also means addressing the complaints some of you voiced about the combat system. Here's a full changelog:

[b]NEW GAME +[/b]
[list]
[*] Load your final save game after beating the campaign to start NG+
[*] Start with all the character progress and arsenal intact
[*] Face more powerful standard enemies that leave behind more essence
[*] Encounter rare overpowered Essence Conduit enemies that just GLOW with power
[*] Essence Conduits are larger, and much meaner than their standard counterparts
[*] Essence Conduits drop MASSIVE amounts of essence if you manage to defeat them
[*] There's a higher chance of Essence Conduits spawning in each subsequent NG+ run
[*] Each subsequent New Game+ run becomes harder, but yields higher rewards
[/list]

[b]COMBAT SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
[*] Parrying and blocking no longer in input queue
[*] Failed parry penalty decreased by 20%
[*] You can now break the counterattacks of shielded enemies with a kick and stagger them
[*] Blocking has been revamped
[*] Block no longer has a cooldown
[*] Block-breaking attacks no longer does damage, unless you don't defend at all
[*] Parry-breaking attacks will cause damage
[*] Parry- and block-breaking attacks from the enemies are less frequent
[*] The Old Blade has been boosted to make the early game combat less punishing
[*] The Coffer Hammer no longer blocks unblockable attacks - it delivers an unblockable heavy attack instead
[*] More consistent enemy staggering and throwing off ledges
[/list]

[b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b]
[list]
[*] Difficulty tiers have been re-balanced and work more in-depth - received damage, enemy attack speed, phial healing amount, and phial number after respawn is affected
[*] Steam Cloud Save feature is now enabled
[*] Brightness setting slider has been introduced in the menu
[*] Some of the Catacombs enemies have been re-deployed in new positions
[*] Scorpions will take longer to turn around
[*] Small scorpions are easily staggered
[*] A bug causing the Jurmum Arena bosses not to spawn on rare occasion has been tracked down and squashed with extreme prejudice
[/list]

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete achievement system overhaul to make sure all unlock properly
[*] A progress bar added to The Elderborn achievement
[*] Corrected descriptions to The Gravekeeper, Jurmum's Garbage Collector, Gotta Catch Them All, and Winston Wolf achievements
[*] Steam notifications for achievement progress tracking
[*] Some problematic enemies excluded from the achievement requirements
[*] New achievement: Groundhog Day - complete NG+ for the first time
[*] New achievement: A Challenger Appears - complete all challenges
[*] New achievement: Winner's Don't Do Drugs - kill 10 Essence Conduits
[/list]

notes.title: Coming this week: New Game+ and more
notes.content:
[b]Warriors![/b] We know most of you are probably in the middle of razing hell right now, but we've been busy as well and a short announcement is in order. 

You've been asking for a way to pick up your adventure and continue after you beat the game. The update [b]coming this Thursday, at 10am PST[/b], will bring about a New Game+ mode that will allow you to do just that! Just load your save file after you finish the campaign, and you will start over in the Catacombs with all the unlocked skills and collected weapons from your first playthrough at your disposal. You might think this will make ELDERBORN easy. Think. Again.

[b]New Game+ [/b]makes all the enemies stronger (but also - worth more essence!). But that's not all. This time around you will notice some of the foes stand out. Watch out for Essence Conduits, enemies filled with the unearthly power so much, that they literally radiate with it. They're bigger, tougher, and meaner then their standard counterparts. But the bounty for slaying them is much greater as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/2947247c80f4628b4d5c3d8c69eb2a67a749947b.jpg[/img]

You might find yourself finishing the game again. We won't stop you from continuing in New Game++, New Game+++ and so on. Each time with a greater challenge that calls for greater skill, but brings about greater rewards. New Game+ mode(s) are the very core of the upcoming update. But that's not all. 

[h2]Improved combat[/h2]

The vast majority of players enjoyed the brutal FPP melee combat in ELDERBORN tremendously. We're very happy to see that the most important mechanic in the game is received so well. Over 85% positive user reviews makes us really proud and humbled at the same time. But it also incites dedication to make the game work even better, so we're looking even closer at those few reviews that focus on the game's problems. We're very grateful that some of the players that did not enjoy the version of ELDERBORN they received after the launch were still kind enough to leave lots of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BlueMaxima/recommended/727850/]solid feedback[/url] in their thumbs-down reviews.

We were very careful not to break what didn't feel broken for most of the players, but we figured out [i]what we can[/i] do to make the input queuing less of an issue for the rest. This also called for some weapon re-balancing and even enemy placement alterations. Be here on Thursday and find out what has changed, exactly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/55e96dc0b3d74022da549d5f8bbc55c6eba903fd.gif[/img]

[h2]Fixes and polish[/h2]

You'll get a full changelog but there are a few things worth mentioning today. The Achievement system got a full overhaul, as many of you reported some problems with some of them. There's also a bunch of new achievements - of course - tied with the NG+ mode, but not only those. By request, we've added a brightness setting slider to the menu. Also by popular request - ELDERBORN will now take advantage of Steam's Cloud Save feature. We've made the pesky scorpions a little less pesky and more prone to stagger. We... 

Oh, nevermind. You'll find out soon enough. See you this Thursday, when the update goes live.

[h3]Stay Metal, Warriors![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/91d6be19b6fe4063c048e62c0a398709bafaf311.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE #1 - fixes and polish
notes.content:
[b]Warriors![/b] We've been following your feedback post game launch and we're very happy to see you enjoy ELDERBORN so much. Bringing fun and joy through ancient ultra-violence was always our life goal! That's why we were even more keen on solving the problems some of you were encountering in-game. As we said earlier, we were working on a polish-bugfix-quality-of-life patch. The patch is now life, and here are the change log highlights:

[list]
[*] An option to respawn at the last savepoint has been added to the menu, to help the player in the rare occasion of being stuck in the world map (this still works as a regular death, so no one gets the idea to abuse this mechanics for free fast-travel)
[*] Achievements should now update properly and instantly
[*] "OK Boomer" and "Big F****g Sword" should now work properly
[*] General achievements fixes
[*] A bug causing the player to respawn incorrectly at the place where they died if they quit the game too quiclky ave been fixed
[*] In the second bossfight Anane should not teleport inside the arena wall anymore
[*] Prompt pop-up and pop-away bugs have been fixed
[*] Animation fixes in Ceramic Kopesh and Old Blade weapons
[*] You can no longer trigger the Kopesh special ability by hitting corpses
[*] Knockback should no longer make enemies clip through walls...
[*] ... nor should it make the player clip through walls
[*] "Gravekeeper" and "Jurmum's garbage collector" no longer require bosses
[*] You can now check the index for your progress in enemy kill count and essence gained count
[*] The color of the particles that Anane emits has been fixed
[*] Minor in-game text fixes
[*] ...other minor fixes and polish
[/list]

We've put ELDERBORN through a few rounds of pre-release QA tests, which resulted in relatively bug-free launch, and the Windows 7-specific bug that occurred, has been tracked down and fixed promptly. Your help and feedback was instrumental in locating the bugs and issues listed above - [b]thank you[/b]! We'll stay vigilant and put those bugs down no matter how many times they try to raise their ugly heads :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/93cf8d3834813e85f1921ef270dc900e91c58564.gif[/img]

[h1]PLUS[/h1]

We mentioned in the previous post, that we're already thinking about ELDERBORN's future. We are already on our way towards the post-release [b]content update[/b]. Again - we're following your feedback closely. We can see that many of your reviews mention the sub-optimal way that ELDERBORN handles blocks an parry. We'll look into it! But that's on the "polish" side of things. Now, about that content.

We know that a [b]New Game+[/b] feature is among your most popular requests. Putting it short: it's underway. We've quite a lot of ideas but - again - we'd love to hear from you about the NG+ you'd love to see. Talk to you soon!

[h3]Stay metal, Warriors![/h3]

notes.title: What comes next for ELDERBORN?
notes.content:
[b]Warriors! [/b] After 5 years of work, and 15 months in early access, [b]ELDERBORN has finally launched on Steam[/b]. Your amazing reaction has given our little studio a great boost! We feel a little overwhelmed by all the praise coming from you guys. But not too overwhelmed not to pay close attention to all the feedback and criticism. If Early Access thought us something, than - more than anything else - is to [b]listen to your players[/b].

We managed to pull of the release without any critical bugs, but there are some issues that we know need fixing. We are working on fixing a number of some major, minor, as many of minuscule bugs that we can track (with no small help from you guys - thank you). We will deliver the [b]first patch on February 20th[/b].

At the same time, we're also closely following everything you say about the design and balance of ELDERBORN. While we stand by our basic concepts and the general feel of the game, we know that it will benefit from [b]further polishing and balancing[/b]. Things were meant to be challenging, but not annoying. Over-the-top, but not goofy. We hear you! We evaluate everything you tell us and we're on it. 2-3 weeks after the bug-fix patch, we'll be releasing another, larger patch addressing many of your concerns, further improving the gameplay, and bringing about some quality-of-life improvements to ELDERBORN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/12dd029d21f0954891b4dca029f49f6ce743ad36.gif[/img]
[h2]Fixing? Yes. Expanding? HELL YES![/h2]
The reception ELDERBORN, as well as the sales, put our studio, Hyperstrange, in a position to make some [b]more far-reaching plans[/b]. A small indie team trying to deliver an ambitious project - and a 3D action game is always such - almost unavoidably faces some difficult choices. The game you got is as awesome and epic as we could deliver, but not as awesome and epic as the one we imagined. We've put our heart and soul into the world of ELDERBORN and now, that it has won [i]you[/i] over, it deserves to be expanded. 

Following the aforementioned patches, we'll start looking into ways we can improve and expand the game further. We know we're knocking on the doors of action game development Valhalla, but we haven't yet earned our places at the table alongside Romero and Carmac just yet. [b]There's even more epic, Metal AF, over-the-top fun to be infused into ELDERBORN[/b], an we have every intention of doing so.

[h3][b]Stay metal, Warriors![/b][/h3]

notes.content:
[h1]The time of glory is upon us, Warriors![/h1]
By this time next week, you will stand in the arena to face trial by combat, prove your worth, and set off to your holy quest to conquer the dangers and mysteries of the ancient and cursed city of Jurmum! [b]ELDERBORN[b] is coming out of Early Access on January 30. Here is what you need to know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/d285b98835cb999a4424e55532c7c3c967a89e52.gif[/img]

15 months of Early Access with awesome player feedback gave us the chance to expand and polish our vision. Current Early Access version, last updated in October 2019, is now best treated as an extensive demo of the final version of ELDERBORN. If you just purchased it - please keep in mind that taking it for a spin now is fun, but you don't want to invest a lot of your time in the game. Because it WILL CHANGE A LOT, and - for the final time - the save files will be wiped. As annoying as that might be - please understand, that the final version of ELDERBORN that comes on Jan 30 will be a lot like a whole new game. Please read on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/48d4319c205e07abd3f25309be0496a25daa55b0.png[/img]

[h2]Full release changelog highlights:[/h2]

[b]What was added?[/b]
[list]
[*] Two new locations - tutorial dungeon, and endgame - atop of the existing Catacombs and City
[*] New animated story intro and cut-scenes in two versions (see next bulletpoints!)
[*] New, more buffed-out character models (plural! see next point!)
[*] The option to choose your character - a male- or female-appearing (this is reflected in the cut-scenes)
[*] The option to choose your preferred difficulty level at the beginning of the game, and change it later if you find it too challenging or not challenging enough (you can do it at any time and it won't affect challenge progression or your eligibility for achievements)
[*] Lore codex detailing the story background, weapons, enemies, and more
[*] A new, second boss fight in the City area
[*] In-game challenges that grant you various bonuses upon completion
[*] A heroic-fantasy storyline to follow throughout the game
[*] New steam achievements
[*] Full controller support 
[*] 5 new weapons
[*] New music tracks
[/list]

[b]What was improved?[/b]
[list]
[*] The user interface has been completely re-worked, both all menu screens, as well as the HUD
[*] The game optimization has been greatly improved and it should run much smoother on most machines within the suggested specs
[*] Complete re-balance of the player, weapon, and enemy stats
[*] Character progression curve was re-balanced as well
[*] Enemy combat patterns and animations
[*] Weapon stats and variance - each of the 11 weapons offers a distinctive playstyle now - check the in-game weapons codex to find out about the different damage types and special properties
[*] You master weapons by using them in combat to unlock more weapon lore and bonuses
[*] You learn about enemies by fighting them and you unlock more lore and learn about their vulnerabilities
[*] The City location has been greatly polished and spruced up with new special effects and more apparent goals
[*] The tower-top mini-boss fights have been reworked completely from the ground up
[*] More spawn points have been added to reduce back-tracking in case of character death
[*] The missing SFX have been added and the existing ones have been improved
[*] The save system back-end has been changed to avoid savegame errors
[*] A lot of bug-fixes and quality-of-life tweaks have been made
[/list]

This list does not include all of the major, minor, and invisible changes that the Hyperstrange team put in ELDERBORN over the course of the last ~4 months since the last update. But it should give you an idea what to expect from the final game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/fdc5839b5dcd5fca664bfd414012435d3cc4b0b8.png[/img]

[b]WARRIORS![/b] The game that we set out to make 5 years ago as a two-person team has evolved into something much bigger, better, and more badass (sorry! had to go there) than we would have imagined. We're still a small team (under 10 people, not counting voice talents, supporting artists, and other freelancers). ELDERBORN is an ambitious indie game, but an indie game nonetheless! We don't have the monetary leverage in marketing of a A-tier title. 

If you enjoy the game and appreciate what we're doing with it, please consider helping us out a bit to gain more visibility. Follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ELDERBORNgame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderborn]Facebook[/url] and consider sharing our posts. Tell your friends about the Metal AF experience that will let them unleash their inner barbarian!

If you happen to be a content creator of any sorts - a streamer, youtuber, blogger - or part of the gaming media, please reach out to us for a review copy of the game. We will to try to reach you on our own, but shooting us an email at elderborn@hyperstrange.com will greatly speed up that process! 

We'll see you all next week, on the other side of Early Access!

Yours, The HYPERSTRANGE Team

notes.content:
Warriors! After a long journey full of challenging side quests and adventure, [b]ELDERBORN[/b] is in the final stretch of development. We'll be announcing the date of our full release in a few dayss, but first things first. Let’s talk about all the awesome new things happening to the game on Steam today!

[h1][b]ELDERBORN + Soundtrack + Digital Artbook = Metal AF Edition[/b][/h1]

We're adding a bunch of digital goodies to ELDERBORN on Steam. Music buffs will be happy to learn that this includes the full game OST - a 10-track album composed by Kacper Kajzerski. Kacper uses the exotic sound of the Armenian duduk and Turkish oud or zurna, among other instruments, to capture the uniqueness of the game’s setting. The music, however, remains true to the modern heavy metal form, with all its defining characteristics. A touch of electronic beats complete the aeclectic, unmistakable mixture that defines the sound of ELDERBORN.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/c973cefe7d49e0f8b54dfcbaad7ee7d12e63aa38.png[/img]

The second piece of digital bonus content is an artbook we’ve prepared for you, so you can see the amazingly varied collection of concept arts that helped us to put the vision of ELDERBORN together, and learn a little bit more of the game’s lore. All this you get in the [b]$19.77 edition[/b], that from this day forth shall be known as [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12630/ELDERBORN_Metal_AF_Edition/]ELDERBORN - Metal AF Edition[/url][/b]. On top of our utmost gratitude, everyone who has bought the game in Early Access up to this date gets a free upgrade to this deluxe version.

[h1][b]Just the game, please![/b][/h1]

Today, we are introducing a second, basic purchase option for ELDERBORN. [b]Priced at $14.99, the standard edition includes the game and the game only[/b]. When we released ELDERBORN into Steam Early Access a bit over one year ago, some external factors dictated both the price point and the formula of the release. Today, being in full control of our game, we want to make sure to give everyone the right option to get into ELDERBORN. This basic option gets you the complete game, and both editions will be equally supported. The only thing you’ll be missing out on in this option, are the digital goodies - the artbook and the soundtrack. But hey, if you decide you love the game - you can always get them separately. Why don't you listen to the first track and see if that helps you decide!

[previewyoutube=47ZBjfJnkD0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]More good news: lowering the requirements[/h1]

As we progress towards release, ELDERBORN becomes more stable, optimized, and QA tested on more systems. At this point, [b]we feel confident enough to substantially lower the system requirements[/b] presented on the Steam store profile. In fact - we did this a while ago, but we’re bringing it up in case it escaped your attention. As of now, we’re confident that a rig equipped with NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780M, Intel Core i5-7500, and 4GB RAM is enough to run ELDERBORN comfortably. That said - the game requires to be played in 40FPS or more to be what we want it to be. If your machine can’t pull it off - consider lowering the resolution in favor of more FPS.

notes.title: Update #5: Call of Jurmum
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/f59fdf1559fa47fd951832af788f7866492c745a.png[/img]
[h1]Warriors! [/h1]
The gates of Jurmum, the ancient, mysterious city are now open. [b]ELDERBORN, the metal melee slash `em up, receives its biggest content update yet.[/b] The Sun will shine on the brave, once more. Those of you who braved the many dangers of the catacombs, faced the titanic guardian Janus, and survived, can now venture forth into the forlorn streets, squares, and back alleys of the cursed town. This new location greatly expands the playtime and introduces a whole new selection of enemies, secrets, and puzzles.

On top of the new location this update also introduces a [b]brand new graphical user interface[/b], rebalances and adds some polish to the combat, makes the enemies more responsive, and [b]improves the overall player experience[/b] by a multitude of smaller and larger tweaks, fixes, and additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/71f97926e381ec20590fced1f8d37efcda7ff9fd.gif[/img]

Yet again, ELDERBORN has changed a lot, as games in early access often do. The game is best enjoyed from the very beginning, so once again - we apologize, but your old save files won't work. But it’s for the best - you’ll see!  A lot of the changes are the direct result of the feedback we’ve been getting from you - our fantastic community of players. Thank you, and please keep it coming! [b]With all the new content we’re very anxious to hear from you[/b], so let us know how are you enjoying the first instalment of the city gameplay in this “[i]Call of Jurmum[/i]” update.

With the fully-playable city location, [b]we are drawing near the conclusion of our story[/b]. Solving the mystery of Jurmum paves the road to ELDERBORN’s grand finale. We’ll tell you more about it soon. For now, answer the Call of Jurmum, warriors! Enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/48d4319c205e07abd3f25309be0496a25daa55b0.png[/img]

[list]
[*] A new stage - the city of Jurmum - has been added to the game with all-new locations, enemies, puzzles, and mini-boss fights
[*] DURING FIGHT Npc positioning is a bit less random. They act less like a mob now.
[*] Damage, hit points and experience values significantly changed across all types of enemies.
[*] The flow of the Janus boss battle has been re-designed - Janus will talk to the player during the fight
[*] New, more buffed character hands model, to make all those hammer swings look more awesome
[*] Mummy behavior changed, it’s more aggressive now.
[*] Small scorpions are weaker but also much faster.
[*] Stone scorpions heal themselves during fight when their hit points reach a certain threshold
[*] Lava scorpions leave pools of fire after they die.
[*] Drowner behavior changed, it’s less aggressive.
[*] NEW NPC: Albino Drowner – stronger version of the drowner with an additional ranged attack
[*] NEW NPC: Berserker – Hight damage and durability, a foe to be feared.
[*] NEW NPC: Stalker – An npc that attacks only when surrounded by allies.
[*] NEW NPC: Firestarter – Fire bomb hurling enemy.
[*] NEW NPC: Assassin – Npc with the ability to teleport behind players back.
[*] NEW NPC: Golden Army Soldier – Golden army solider armed with a two handed sword. All attack zero defense.
[*] NEW NPC: Golden Army Man at Arms – Golden Army Soldier with a spear and an ability to charge.
[*] NEW NPC: Golden Army Artillery – Golden Army Soldier with a strange weapon.
[*] NEW NPC: Golden Army Shieldbearer – Golden Army Soldier with a small shield, they protect the artillery.
[*] NEW NPC: Walking Corpse – Feral among the ferals. The least human of Jurmum citizens.
[*] NEW NPC: Priest – The  clergy of Jurmum with the ability to manipulate the elements.
[*] Added a lot of consistency to the combat system. Everything should feel more balanced now.
[*] The user interface has been re-designed (again!), including a brand-new HUD
[*] New skill and stats screen has been added
[*] Added a “Codex” screen where the player can review tutorials, and learn more about the game’s lore, locations, weapons, items, and enemies Added proper Character sheet to the game
[*] The time needed to complete the action of picking up lost sou… essence has been greatly reduced
[*] New music tracks have been introduced to the game and the system handling music and sound effects has been reworked from scratch.
[*] New mid-intro has been added to bridge the Catacombs (dungeon) and Jurmum (city) stages
[*] Game optimization and stability has been greatly improved
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30880490/fdc5839b5dcd5fca664bfd414012435d3cc4b0b8.png[/img]

To celebrate this milestone we're putting the game on a [b]week-long -20% discount[/b] tomorrow, at 10:00am PST! If you've been eyeing ELDERBORN for some time now, this is the perfect time to pick it up and give it a go. There's twice as much content in it now, and we're almost at the point of our full release (sometime early 2020).

At this point, where the majority of content and gameplay is already IN the game, we're looking for your input to help us polish the game and achieve its peak potential. Your feedback and support means THE WORLD to us!
If you like what you see, please leave us a steam review.
If you want to give us live feedback and get an insider look at the development - join us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/2wu7Cpj]DISCORD[/url]!
If you wish to see ELDERBORN grow, please consider following us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderborn/]FACEBOOK[/url] &[url=https://twitter.com/ELDERBORNgame]TWITTER[/url] and posting about us.

Thank you, warriors, and good hunting!

notes.title: Early Access Update 4: Combat Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/77f9d6c4f1321dada675ef8f82072355c003b772.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Warriors![/h1][/b]
Once more we’re diving deep into the core of [b]ELDERBORN[/b] to make some game-changing decisions. Some of them you will see at the first glimpse (the user interface paying tribute to FPS hall of fame classics) others need to be experienced to be recognized (new player movement and combat control).

The game is now harder and more demanding but also you get greater control over the character's combat style. When you want to eliminate undead with one precise hit, go with the strength. If you feel that movement is too clumsy you now can level up your speed. Want to tank bigger groups of enemies like a berserker? Resilience is there for you. Yes. [b]You get to progress and build the character's attributes the way you want and get the experience better suited to your play style.[/b] The changes in this update are extensive, so [strike]we encourage you to start over and[/strike] experience the game in its new flavor from the very beginning ([i]in fact… we'll just wipe out the saved games, so you don't really have a choice. Sorry![/i])

Some may wonder, what of the City Content Update that was going to be the next in line, according to our roadmap. Worry not! The City is taking its final form as we speak and you'll get to fight your way through its terraces, alleys, and squares soon enough. But[b] the player feedback you were providing us turned our attention towards game mechanics first[/b]. And it would be a poor choice of order if we released a new map with the old mechanics, just to rebalance it for the new features soon after. Yes, the City is well underway, but core gameplay takes priority.

In this update we are breaking some of the limits we've put on ourselves at the beginning of [b]ELDERBORN[/b]'s development and explore the unknown. This makes your feedback even more important than ever before.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/48d4319c205e07abd3f25309be0496a25daa55b0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We’ve introduced a graphical interface to make [b]keeping track of your health[/b] and other factors easier and to pay a tribute to some old-school metal-hearted shooters we love
[*] Health regen is out by default - do keep track of your health!
[*] Enemy attack can now [b]disrupt your action[/b] - be more mindful of their movements!
[*] Hitting your enemies back lets you [b]partially regain your HP loss[/b], and the faster you do it, the more health you get back - strike back quick!
[*] Enemies now drop “[b]essence[/b]” and there are "essence cashes" scattered across the environment
[*] Essence fills phials, that you can use to [b]heal yourself[/b]
[*] Essence also [b]serves as XP[/b] that you can spend it while meditating at the fountains (use the fountain for a second time after saving, to distribute attribute points and unlock skills)
[*] When you die, you drop all the essence you were carrying, but it will remain there and you’ll get one [b]chance to recover it[/b] after you respawn at the fountain
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/f9f940d29830e3a29b545fd8364787a55a8ab50b.png[/img]
Each of the attributes that you can develop, comes with a set of three unique skills - active or passive - that will become unlockable after you bring the attribute to the required level. Two first skills are treated as basic, while the third is considered the ultimate skill in the given tree, and requires unlocking at least one of the basic skills in that tree first. That’s a total of 9 skills giving you the ability to shape your character build in line with your play style.

[h1]STRENGTH TREE:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Charge[/b]: Find your balance, build up momentum and launch a charge towards your enemies, breaking their stance, staggering, and hurting them
[*] [b]Rip and tear[/b]: Reach down towards a fallen foe, rip their head right off their shoulders, and hurl it violently towards another enemy
[*] [b]Stomp[/b]: Launch into the air and drop like a bomb on the heads of your foes launching a shockwave as you reach the ground
[/list]
[h1]SPEED TREE:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Essence hunter: Stop wasting time chasing after essence dropped by slain foes - now you pull essence towards you, over distance
[*] Reflect projectile: Time a parry right to knock a projectile launched by the foe out of its path, and right into your closest enemy
[*] Air dash: Even gravity has no dominion over you! Dashing is now possible even in mid-jump or while falling
[/list]
[h1]RESILIENCE TREE:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Too stubborn to slay:[/b] When your health drops to zero and you’d normally die, you get one more chance to kill a foe and thus regain full health
[*] [b]Licking your wounds:[/b] If your health is very low, find a safe spot, catch some breath, and slowly regain up to 40% of your HP
[*][b] Barbaric rage:[/b] you speed up, the world slows down, and with every kill you regain some health
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/fdc5839b5dcd5fca664bfd414012435d3cc4b0b8.png[/img]
This is an important chapter in the development of ELDERBORN, warriors! The game now has more complexity than ever and it’s closer to what we imagined - the embodiment of modern git good gameplay philosophy wrapped up in single-player, old-school, heavy metal, brutal goodness. We’re getting there - this isn’t even our final form, but it’s significantly closer to our ultimate vision. Your feedback and support means THE WORLD to us now. 
If you like what you see, please leave us a steam review. 
If you want to give us live feedback and get an insider look at the development - join us on [url=https://discord.gg/2wu7Cpj][b]DISCORD[/b][/url]!
If you wish to see ELDERBORN grow, please consider following us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderborn/][b]FACEBOOK[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ELDERBORNgame][b]TWITTER[/b][/url], & [url=https://twitter.com/ELDERBORNgame][b]INSTAGRAM[/b][/url], and posting about us.

Thank you, [b]warriors[/b], and good hunting!

notes.title: TECH UPDATE #2 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
WARRIORS!

The end of February brings you the second Tech Update!

The main objective of ELDERBORN Early Access is to develop our game based on your feedback. And the latest update, which is now available, follows this strategy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/afd2461834f84fb79cc8d6df4faae66d1ff750d0.png[/img]

Some of you have said that the game does not contain enough blood, while others complained about the amount of gore. What did we do to make both groups satisfied? We added a new setting! When playing the game, you can choose between:
- no gore,
- particles,
- particles + decals.
Unfortunately, for now, we are unable to satisfy those of you who asked for limb dismemberment.

We also need to mention the full controller support, which we couldn't deliver on time which we decided to push at the end of Early Access due to multiple ongoing changes in core game mechanics. Maintaining its consistency turned out to be much more time consuming than we originally expected and we decided to move this feature implementation closer to the release, prioritizing bringing you new content over full controller support in every incoming version. Of course, keep in mind that the controller can still be used in the game (if you are using a PS4 controller, it requires Steam running in Big Picture). The only drawback is that menus are not accessible when using a controller.

Last but not least, make sure to pay our discord a visit - let's talk about the future of ELDERBORN! https://discord.gg/2wu7Cpj

notes.content:

The end of January brings you the first Content Update![/b]

We also feel that the game has been too easy, so we introduced some changes which should make it more difficult. We are looking forward to hearing your opinion on how the game is evolving, as well as how do you find the Janus bossfight - we'd love to know what you think about him, please share your strats with us! Maybe you have any exploits to beat him easily?

notes.content:
Today we have brought you the first Early Access update!

As listed in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/727850/announcements/detail/1702816964469981973]roadmap[/url] published shortly after the Early Access release, Tech Update #1 brings some new features and gameplay changes, including those based on your feedback. We want to strengthen the fundaments of our game before adding more content early next year.

Some changes have been implemented, some not, some are still being discussed - you can find out why below and as always, let us know how do you find how the game has changed and... [b]keep being awesome[/b]! \m/

PS Don't forget about our livestream starting at 10AM PST!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30880490/c81b2cbcb128a9d343ab8426ccef7b5af1b4ffa0.jpg[/img]

[list][*] [b]Some changes are based on your feedback and some just follow the design decisions so we:[/b]

Added option to map buttons
Added option to turn on direction double tap to Dash
Added option to toggle crosshair (may help if you are feeling dizzy sometimes)
Fixed camera movement during attacks and walking (should feel more weighty now)
Fixed AI a bit (Shielded zombies actually use shields now)
Added a lot more player HP, so you can face this improved AI with no frustration
Changed enviro a bit, to keep the game tempo
Changed enemies’ placement for the same reason
Added a hitstop effect to each connecting attack, feedback on hit is now cooler
Rebalanced all weapon categories, changes in range and knockback power
Reduced parry window, you guys were too good at it
Highlighted traces of enemy ranged attacks
Nerfed Kick: bigger recovery, less pushback. But now deals a bit of damage! :D
Fixed sound options

Left some enemy items in-game after you slay them

[*] [b]The main focus at the moment:[/b]

Dungeon - Boss Fight
Dungeon - Hell section
Story introduction
Treasures are being reworked, but we are not sure when will we introduce them in the new approach. Also, we are testing some power-ups ideas
The City is growing

[*] [b]What didn’t we do and why:[/b]


Flying limbs and corpse interaction - for now, it’s overkill for game optimization. Even if it works somehow, we will not include it anytime soon due to game performance
Player ranged attacks - still no ranged combat for you but… we have an idea that we want to discuss with you sometime soon, on discord maybe
Stealth and glory kills - even if we would love to make it true, we can’t. Time cost could kill the process of finishing the game and possibly the core game design also. Too risky.
Enemies reanimation. Some of you don’t like it and want it to go away but it has its reason and purpose. There is a connection between your respawn and theirs... More on this in January! :)
